// Scratch generator: EIP-712 digest oracle for every user transaction body type, written by Accumulate itself
// (protocol.EIP712Hash).
package main

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math/big"
	"math/rand"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"time"

	"gitlab.com/accumulatenetwork/accumulate/pkg/url"
	"gitlab.com/accumulatenetwork/accumulate/protocol"
)

type enumLike interface {
	SetEnumValue(uint64) bool
	String() string
}

type filler struct {
	r      *rand.Rand
	sparse float64
	nuni   int
}

func (f *filler) word() string {
	const letters = "abcdefghijklmnop"
	n := 3 + f.r.Intn(6)
	b := make([]byte, n)
	for i := range b {
		b[i] = letters[f.r.Intn(len(letters))]
	}
	return string(b)
}

func (f *filler) url() *url.URL {
	return url.MustParse("acc://" + f.word() + ".acme/" + f.word() + "/" + f.word())
}

func (f *filler) bytes(n int) []byte {
	b := make([]byte, n)
	f.r.Read(b)
	return b
}

func validEnums(t reflect.Type) []uint64 {
	var out []uint64
	for i := uint64(0); i < 64; i++ {
		v := reflect.New(t)
		e, ok := v.Interface().(enumLike)
		if !ok {
			return nil
		}
		if e.SetEnumValue(i) {
			out = append(out, i)
		}
	}
	return out
}

var tEnum = reflect.TypeOf((*enumLike)(nil)).Elem()

func (f *filler) fill(v reflect.Value, depth int) {
	t := v.Type()
	switch {
	case t == reflect.TypeOf((*url.URL)(nil)):
		v.Set(reflect.ValueOf(f.url()))
		return
	case t == reflect.TypeOf((*url.TxID)(nil)):
		var h [32]byte
		f.r.Read(h[:])
		v.Set(reflect.ValueOf(f.url().WithTxID(h)))
		return
	case t == reflect.TypeOf((*big.Int)(nil)):
		v.Set(reflect.ValueOf(new(big.Int).SetBytes(f.bytes(1 + f.r.Intn(9)))))
		return
	case t == reflect.TypeOf(big.Int{}):
		v.Set(reflect.ValueOf(*new(big.Int).SetBytes(f.bytes(1 + f.r.Intn(9)))))
		return
	case t == reflect.TypeOf(time.Time{}):
		v.Set(reflect.ValueOf(time.Unix(1700000000+int64(f.r.Intn(100000000)), 0).UTC()))
		return
	case t == reflect.TypeOf(time.Duration(0)):
		return
	case t == reflect.TypeOf(json.RawMessage{}):
		v.Set(reflect.ValueOf(json.RawMessage(`{"k":1}`)))
		return
	}
	if v.CanAddr() && reflect.PtrTo(t).Implements(tEnum) {
		if ev := validEnums(t); len(ev) > 0 {
			v.SetUint(ev[f.r.Intn(len(ev))])
			return
		}
	}
	switch t.Kind() {
	case reflect.Ptr:
		n := reflect.New(t.Elem())
		f.fill(n.Elem(), depth+1)
		v.Set(n)
	case reflect.Struct:
		if depth > 5 {
			return
		}
		for i := 0; i < t.NumField(); i++ {
			sf := t.Field(i)
			if !sf.IsExported() {
				continue
			}
			if f.r.Float64() < f.sparse {
				continue
			}
			f.fill(v.Field(i), depth+1)
		}
	case reflect.Slice:
		if t.Elem().Kind() == reflect.Uint8 {
			v.SetBytes(f.bytes(1 + f.r.Intn(40)))
			return
		}
		n := 1 + f.r.Intn(3)
		s := reflect.MakeSlice(t, n, n)
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			f.fill(s.Index(i), depth+1)
		}
		v.Set(s)
	case reflect.Array:
		if t.Elem().Kind() == reflect.Uint8 {
			b := f.bytes(t.Len())
			for i := range b {
				v.Index(i).SetUint(uint64(b[i]))
			}
		}
	case reflect.String:
		v.SetString(f.word() + " " + f.word())
	case reflect.Bool:
		v.SetBool(true)
	case reflect.Uint64, reflect.Uint32, reflect.Uint:
		v.SetUint(1 + uint64(f.r.Intn(1000000000)))
	case reflect.Int64, reflect.Int:
		v.SetInt(1 + int64(f.r.Intn(1000000000)))
	case reflect.Interface:
		f.fillUnion(v, depth)
	}
}

func (f *filler) fillUnion(v reflect.Value, depth int) {
	t := v.Type()
	var vals []any
	switch t {
	case reflect.TypeOf((*protocol.DataEntry)(nil)).Elem():
		for i := protocol.DataEntryType(0); i < 8; i++ {
			if x, err := protocol.NewDataEntry(i); err == nil {
				vals = append(vals, x)
			}
		}
	case reflect.TypeOf((*protocol.KeyPageOperation)(nil)).Elem():
		for i := protocol.KeyPageOperationType(0); i < 16; i++ {
			if x, err := protocol.NewKeyPageOperation(i); err == nil {
				vals = append(vals, x)
			}
		}
	case reflect.TypeOf((*protocol.AccountAuthOperation)(nil)).Elem():
		for i := protocol.AccountAuthOperationType(0); i < 16; i++ {
			if x, err := protocol.NewAccountAuthOperation(i); err == nil {
				vals = append(vals, x)
			}
		}
	case reflect.TypeOf((*protocol.NetworkMaintenanceOperation)(nil)).Elem():
		for i := protocol.NetworkMaintenanceOperationType(0); i < 16; i++ {
			if x, err := protocol.NewNetworkMaintenanceOperation(i); err == nil {
				vals = append(vals, x)
			}
		}
	}
	if len(vals) == 0 || depth > 6 {
		return
	}
	pick := vals[f.nuni%len(vals)]
	f.nuni++
	pv := reflect.ValueOf(pick)
	if pv.Kind() == reflect.Ptr {
		n := reflect.New(pv.Type().Elem())
		f.fill(n.Elem(), depth+1)
		v.Set(n)
	}
}

type Vector struct {
	ID          string `json:"id"`
	Body        string `json:"body"`
	Transaction string `json:"transaction"`
	TxHash      string `json:"txHash"`
	Signature   string `json:"signature"`
	ChainID     string `json:"chainId"`
	Hash        string `json:"hash,omitempty"`
	Error       string `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type File struct {
	Format      string   `json:"format"`
	Description string   `json:"description"`
	Accumulate  string   `json:"accumulate"`
	Vectors     []Vector `json:"vectors"`
}

func main() {
	out := &File{
		Format:      "certen:eip712-bodies:v1",
		Description: "EIP-712 digests of typedData signatures over every user transaction body type, written by Accumulate's own protocol.EIP712Hash. Transactions and signatures are populated reflectively from deterministic seeds; an error vector is a transaction and signature that EIP712Hash refuses.",
		Accumulate:  "gitlab.com/accumulatenetwork/accumulate v1.4.7-0.20260926030013-e1d1db9ebb7c",
	}
	perType := 16
	for ti := protocol.TransactionType(1); ti < protocol.TransactionType(protocol.TransactionMaxUser); ti++ {
		probe, err := protocol.NewTransactionBody(ti)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		name := probe.Type().String()
		for k := 0; k < perType; k++ {
			seed := int64(ti)*1000 + int64(k)
			f := &filler{r: rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed)), sparse: []float64{0, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7}[k%4], nuni: k}
			body, _ := protocol.NewTransactionBody(ti)
			f.fill(reflect.ValueOf(body).Elem(), 0)
			txn := new(protocol.Transaction)
			txn.Body = body
			hf := &filler{r: rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed + 7)), sparse: []float64{0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 0.0}[k%4]}
			hf.fill(reflect.ValueOf(&txn.Header).Elem(), 0)
			if txn.Header.Principal == nil {
				txn.Header.Principal = f.url()
			}

			sf := &filler{r: rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed + 13))}
			td := &protocol.TypedDataSignature{
				PublicKey:     sf.bytes(65),
				Signature:     sf.bytes(64),
				Signer:        sf.url(),
				SignerVersion: uint64(1 + sf.r.Intn(9)),
				Timestamp:     uint64(1700000000000 + sf.r.Intn(1000000)),
				ChainID:       protocol.EthChainID("DevNet"),
			}
			if k%3 == 1 {
				td.Vote = protocol.VoteType(1 + sf.r.Intn(3))
			}
			if k%5 == 2 {
				td.Memo = sf.word() + " " + sf.word()
			}
			if k%5 == 3 {
				td.Data = sf.bytes(1 + sf.r.Intn(20))
			}
			if k%4 == 3 {
				td.ChainID = protocol.EthChainID("Kermit")
			}
			var outer protocol.Signature = td
			nd := k % 3
			for d := 0; d < nd; d++ {
				outer = &protocol.DelegatedSignature{Delegator: sf.url(), Signature: outer}
			}
			tb, err := txn.MarshalBinary()
			if err != nil {
				continue
			}
			sb, err := outer.MarshalBinary()
			if err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
			v := Vector{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s/%02d", name, k), Body: name, Transaction: hex.EncodeToString(tb), TxHash: hex.EncodeToString(txn.GetHash()), Signature: hex.EncodeToString(sb), ChainID: td.ChainID.String()}
			if len(os.Args) > 2 && os.Args[2] == v.ID {
				j, _ := protocol.MarshalEip712(txn, outer)
				fmt.Println(string(j))
			}
			h, err := protocol.EIP712Hash(txn, outer)
			if err != nil {
				v.Error = err.Error()
			} else {
				v.Hash = hex.EncodeToString(h)
			}
			out.Vectors = append(out.Vectors, v)
		}
	}
	b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", " ")
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[1], b, 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	nerr := 0
	for _, v := range out.Vectors {
		if v.Error != "" {
			nerr++
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("vectors", len(out.Vectors), "errors", nerr)
}
